title: AVC Main CQP 24 — experimental A/B, uncapped

headset_settings.render_resolution: Keep current; expected baseline 576x640 encoded pixels per eye

notes: CQP-capable branch required. No aggregate bitrate cap or validated total traffic prediction. Earlier single-eye synthetic measurements exclude real stereo/alpha behavior; alpha no longer receives the CBR 1.23% budget share. Content and keyframes determine output rate.
Host options apply equally to left eye, right eye and alpha. Host CBR configurations are identical across bitrate profiles; the actual difference is the required headset bitrate setting.
Host currently supplies max_b_frames=0 and GOP=240. Preset does not change either.
Encoder profile: HEVC Main or H.264 Main; pixel format 8-bit 4:2:0. Target is the selected Intel Arc A770; no brittle render-node override.
